description: How TikTok ate the app world — Instagram grew, Snapchat held steady, Facebook peaked for older generations, and BeReal fizzled after its viral moment. Monthly active users (global, in millions) 2007–2026.
youtube_description: Gen‑Z Social Swap — a chart race that tells a blunt story: TikTok exploded from near-zero to billions of monthly users in a few years while older giants matured and a must‑try app (BeReal) burned bright then faded. This timeline uses public milestones (Facebook hit 1B MAUs in 2012, Instagram reached ~1B in 2018, TikTok surpassed ~1B in 2021; Snapchat IPO'd in 2017; BeReal peaked around 2022 before declining). Watch the race: TikTok's meteoric climb, Instagram's steady scale, Snapchat's steady niche, Facebook's plateau, and BeReal's sharp spike and fall. If you loved this visualization, like, subscribe, and tell us which platform surprised you most — and drop ideas for the next chart race in the comments. Sources: company reports, public MAU announcements, industry trackers (Pew, Data.ai, company filings) — curated and scaled to a consistent global MAU view. #genz #tiktok #socialshift #chartrace #dataviz
